description: The work shell's main window only, and only the two token commands, allowed by name. No core plugin grant, no filesystem, no shell, no device permission (the device grants are the field profile's alone). A tablet scanning at the counter needs no Tauri grant either: the scanner asks for the camera through the webview's own web API, and the OS usage description (Info.plist beside the conf) is the wiring. Once sign in writes it, the core's keychain store keeps the refresh token in the OS keychain and hands only the access token to the app's own origins.
